faqs.question: How long is Raffles’ agriculture course?
faqs.answer: The programme table lists four years and eight semesters.

faqs.question: What practical attachment model does the school describe?
faqs.answer: It names Rural Agricultural Work Experience and Agro-Industrial Attachment.

faqs.question: What is Raffles’ agriculture academic fee for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The signed 2026-27 sheet lists INR 65,000 per year. Registration, admission and refundable security are separate one-time charges; hostel costs are additional.

faqs.question: Are scholarships automatic?
faqs.answer: The university FAQ describes case-by-case consideration by the Gomber Education Foundation, subject to its conditions and available funds.

faqs.question: Should agriculture applicants follow the general Situation Test route?
faqs.answer: The general procedure describes it, but the agriculture compliance report mentions JET scheduling. Confirm the current programme-specific route.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at Raffles University?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/raffles-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Raffles University?
faqs.answer: 4 years (8 semesters). The programme combines agricultural science, farm practicals and a final-year hands-on component.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Raffles University?
faqs.answer: Undated official course page: 10+2 Science/Agriculture with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics/Biology/Agriculture, at least 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Raffles University?
faqs.answer: ₹65,000 / year · 2026-27. Annual academic fee. One-time registration INR 1,000, admission INR 9,000 and refundable academic security INR 5,000 separately; hostel charges excluded. Included charges: Published tuition/course fee; additional charges must be checked separately.

faqs.question: How does admission to Raffles University work?
faqs.answer: The university has a general application and assessment procedure, while its 2023 agriculture self-study compliance report refers to the Rajasthan JET schedule. Obtain the current agriculture-specific route before following the general Situation Test and interview process. Confirm the course: Use the official programme contact to confirm that the listed degree is taking applications for your intended intake. Request the intake notice: Ask for the applicable selection rules, fee breakdown and document checklist before submitting an application.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for Raffles University?
faqs.answer: Raffles University, Neemrana, Alwar, Rajasthan: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 60), recorded term 2024-06-20 to 2029-06-19. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at Raffles University?
faqs.answer: Rural Agricultural Work Experience and Agro-Industrial Attachment are described by the school.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at Raffles University?
faqs.answer: Agricultural subject laboratories: The school identifies laboratories including soils, plant health and crop improvement.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for Raffles University?
faqs.answer: The school names subject laboratories across crop, soil, animal and allied fields. Its RAWE and industry-attachment account describes work outside the classroom with farm and industry communities. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for Raffles University?
faqs.answer: The university FAQ says the Gomber Education Foundation considers scholarship and fee concessions case by case, subject to merit, need and available funds. An agriculture-specific current award amount was not verified.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for Raffles University?
faqs.answer: The school names individual alumni employers, including Dhanuka Agritech and Mondew Agri Science. These examples are not a dated placement rate, typical salary or promise to a future cohort.

faqs.question: How can I contact Raffles University about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: +91-9928777777. Published email: admissions@rafflesuniversity.edu.in. Official admissions: https://rafflesuniversity.edu.in/admission-procedure

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for Raffles University?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://rafflesuniversity.edu.in/admission-procedure; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
